title: Confido
tagline: A trust marketplace where people can offer their services based on their reputation. Reputation being a lifetime score that cannot be changed and it's tied to a human.
description: A trust marketplace where people can offer their services based on their reputation. Reputation being a lifetime score that cannot be changed ans it's tied to a human. Imagine you want someone to deposit money for you or even take care of your child. Those are risky tasks and you shouldn't just stick with a random person. Also, regarding this example tasks, your main goal would be to seek for someone trustful and not only capable of doing a task.
how_its_made: In order to verify human identity, we have used Worldcoin. This also ensures that one person can only have one account, eliminating the problem of users creating multiple accounts circumvent poor reputations. We are also using a smart contract, written in Solidity, holding all the reputation of the users and transactions history. For the frontend we have decided to use Next.js and some other tools of TypeScript.
